**What and why:**

- [ ] One concern; commits are small and say why
- [ ] `npm run check`, `typecheck`, `test` and `test:plugin` pass
- [ ] Tests added; a bug fix has a regression test that failed first
- [ ] Goldens changed only for an intended UI change, and I read the diff
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has a line under `## Unreleased` for a user-visible change
- [ ] Docs a change makes stale are updated; `npm run docs:images` run if the terminal UI changed
- [ ] No secrets or keys, no root lockfile, no engine API newer than the floor
